name: konane
description: 1×n Konane in the browser with an exact combinatorial-game-theory engine: canonical values, every jump marked winning or losing, a golden-ratio argument that splits a row into independent parts, and every table, formula and conjecture of Chan and Tsai's '1×n Konane: A Summary of Results' (2002) recomputed. TypeScript, no runtime deps.

scripts.verify: node tools/sweep.mts && node tools/checks.mts 14 && node tools/checks.mts 14 1800 eee eee-2mod4,eee-2mod4-conj,eee-0mod4,eee-0mod4-conj,eee-2mod4-read,eee-0mod4-read,eee-shift-read && node tools/disputes.mts && node tools/control.mts && node tools/report.mts
